OwnableInvalidOwner(address).details: The owner is not a valid owner account. (eg. `address(0)`)

OwnableUnauthorizedAccount(address).details: The caller account is not authorized to perform an operation.

params._trade: The Trade to apply the Coupon to.

returns._0: The Trade with the Coupon applied.

params._coupons: The list of coupon signatures to be canceled.

params._allowedCoupons: The initial list of allowed Coupons.
params._marketplace: The address of the Marketplace that will be able to apply Coupons.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

allowedCoupons(address).notice: Mapping of the allowed Coupon contracts. If a Coupon is not in this mapping, it will not be allowed to be applied.

applyCoupon((address,bytes,(uint256,uint.notice: Applies a Coupon to a Trade.

cancelSignature((bytes,(uint256,uint256,.notice: Revokes the signatures of all provided coupons. The caller must be the signer of those coupons.

cancelledSignatures(bytes32).notice: Mapping of cancelled signatures. Signers can invalidate any particular signature by adding it to this mapping.

contractSignatureIndex().notice: Value of the current contract signature index. The owner of the contract can update this value to revoke signatures created with another value.

increaseContractSignatureIndex().notice: Allows the owner of the contract to increase the contract signature index. Revokes all signatures created with a previous index.

increaseSignerSignatureIndex().notice: Allows the signer to increase their signature index. Revokes all signatures created by the signer with a previous index.

marketplace().notice: The address of the Marketplace that will be able to apply Coupons. Only this address will be able to apply Coupons.

signatureUses(bytes32).notice: Mapping of signature uses. Tracks how many times a signature has been used. Useful in case the signer wants to determine how many times a signature can be used.

signerSignatureIndex(address).notice: Value of the current signer signature index. Signers can update this value to revoke signatures created with another value.

updateAllowedCoupons(address[],bool[]).notice: Updates the list of allowed Coupons.

updateMarketplace(address).notice: Updates the address of the Marketplace that will be able to apply Coupons.

userdoc.notice: Contract that allows applying Coupons to Trades. It holds the logic to control which Coupons are allowed to be applied. It also manages the Coupon signatures and their uses. This is useful to be able to add or remove new Coupons while still using the same EIP712 domain.
